messages:
Mia: FYI NovaGPU updated lead times for H200 into EU. New ETA 6-8 weeks for reserved pool; need decision on allocation vs RMA short-term.
Ajay: That hits our Q2 commit. Current reserved count in eu-west?
Luke: eu-west-1 reserved: 420 H200s, 356 allocated (85%). Burst pool ~24 available but earmarked.
Sofia: If we move some workloads to H100+quantized we can free ~40 slots, but risk regressions. Can vendor expedite partial shipments?
Evelyn (NovaGPU): We can split ship: 50% by sea (6-8w) + 20 air-expedite in 2-3w. Air has expedite surcharge and needs advanced customs docs.
Mia: Send rates. Need cost delta vs accepting vendor RMAs available now. Any RMA batches?
Evelyn (NovaGPU): 30 certified RMA units in NL depot ready for cross-dock. Tested, 12-mo warranty; ~18% discount vs new; ETA 3-5 days for handoff.
Ajay: Reminder: RMAs cannot be used for HIPAA customers. Which clusters are flagged?
Luke: HIPAA/regulated tenants: 7 clusters pinned to dedicated pools (customers A, B, C) cannot take refurbished. Others (dev/research/analytics) can.
Sofia: Proposal: Use 30 RMA units for non-regulated burst workloads now; for regulated workloads, take 20 air-expedite H200s and backfill remainder by sea. Approve if cost delta within budget.
Mia: Put rough numbers in one line for finance.
Evelyn (NovaGPU): Rate summary:
new H200 (sea): $23,800/unit, ETA 6-8w;
new H200 (air-expedite): $29,500/unit, ETA 2-3w (includes expedite fee);
RMA H200 (refurb, NL depot): $19,520/unit, ETA 3-5 days, 12-mo warranty;
Customs + import VAT (EU): ~€1,200/unit (sea), ~€1,850/unit (air).
Luke: Calc: 20 air units to cover regulated pools => delta vs sea ≈ $5,700 + ~€650 VAT diff ≈ +$6.3k/unit landed; incremental ≈ $126k. RMA saves ≈ $4.3k/unit vs new sea landed.
Ajay: Ops risk: RMAs DOA ~1.8% vs new 0.9%. With 30 RMAs expect ~0.5-1 unit re-replace overhead. Acceptable.
Mia: Approval ask: procurement to sign for 20 air units + accept 30 RMAs for non-regulated pools. Need PO wording for split shipments and RMA acceptance criteria.
Evelyn (NovaGPU): PO suggested wording: "split shipment allowed; air-expedite for first 20 H200s; remainder by sea; RMA units acceptable for non-regulated SKUs; 30 RMAs reserved under holding ID NOVA-RMA-0911."
Sofia: Add clause: vendor replaces DOA RMA within 72h or provides loaner pool.
VendorOpsBot: [vendor-ops] created RMA hold NOVA-RMA-0911, reserved 30 units, expected release window 3 business days.
Luke: Logistics: cross-dock NL -> FRA hub -> DDP EU distribution. Need customs docs 48h pre-move. Evelyn, confirm EORI and commercial invoice format?
Evelyn (NovaGPU): Confirmed. Will upload commercial invoice + EORI and batch serial manifest under the PO ticket by EOD.
Ajay: Cost centers: expedite cost split product alpha 70% / infra contingency 30%. Finance ok?
Mia: Finance approves up to $150k incremental expedite spend; above requires CFO sign-off.
Sofia: Action items: (1) Procurement issue PO with split-shipment + RMA clause, (2) Evelyn upload invoices & serial manifest, (3) Infra tag non-regulated pools for RMA placement, (4) Ops monitor DOA metrics daily for 7 days post-handoff.
Mia: I'll draft the PO. Compliance: regulated clusters cannot accept RMA — double-check tenant mapping in console before tagging.
Luke: I'll write quick runbook for RMA onboarding (sanity checks, firmware reconcile, KV cache wipe).
Evelyn (NovaGPU): Holding air capacity for 48h pending PO. Please confirm by 1600 UTC.
Mia: Confirmed. Proceed with PO draft and tagging. Will update thread after PO issued. :thumbsup:
